name: reset-password-01
title: Reset Password 01 - The Screen Most Of Its Life Is Expired
description: A new secret with a reveal control named in the caller's own language, a repeat that is not compared for the caller, a strength note that is the caller's own function of what has been typed, one submit control, an announced status region, and an expired arm that takes the form away rather than letting a reader type into it only to be refused. Whether the two entries match is the product's validation and the words beside the mismatch are its too, so this Block draws no comparison and no sentence. Every string is passed in as a prop.
